summary: This bill authorizes a grant program to help state and local law enforcement agencies purchase body-worn cameras and manage the recorded data, while also requiring specific policies for data collection, retention, and privacy, and mandating studies on the cameras' effectiveness and impact.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a grant program for law enforcement agencies to purchase body-worn cameras and manage the recorded data. It aims to deter excessive force, improve accountability, and assist in evidence collection, which directly relates to stricter justice and stronger policing by enhancing oversight and evidence gathering, while also promoting accountability.
